title: ON THE SHORE BEYOND THE SEA
stanzas: On the shore beyond the sea, where the fields are bright and fair, there's a call, a plaintive plea, I must hasten to be there.
Hark! I hear the master say, "Up ye reapers! why so slow?" To the vineyard, far away, earthly kindred, let me go.
Father mother, darling child, I must bid you all adieu; Far across the waters wild, there's a work for me to do.
chorus: Let me go, I cannot stay, 'Tis the master calling me; Let me go I must obey; Native land farewell to thee
